about: HF architecture classes reviewed as NOT aliases of a supported family (docs/arch-gaps.md). tools/registry_build.py --check-gaps fails if one becomes mapped without a 'mapped_ok' reason.

DeepseekV41ForCausalLM.family: DeepSeek V4.1 (engram embeddings + candidate-block sparse attention; NOT an alias of deepseek4 - different layer/head/expert shape, and the V4 path runs neither, which is why it needed its own port)
DeepseekV41ForCausalLM.mapped_ok: the pinned backend implements it as its own architecture: third_party/llama.cpp 5e6388a5a maps DeepseekV41ForCausalLM -> deepseek41 (conversion/__init__.py), registers LLM_ARCH_DEEPSEEK41 (src/llama-arch.cpp) and implements hparams/tensors/graph/engram in src/models/deepseek41.cpp - fork #156, the port of upstream #31086 + #31300. tools/registry_build.py --check-gaps stays quiet for this class; docs/arch-gaps.md carries the dated note.

EnglishBaseForCausalLM.family: relu2 MLP + parameter-free QK-norm (implemented in the old engine only)

DFlash2DraftModel.family: DFlash2 speculative drafter (speculators; selector + conv heads the pinned dflash does not run)

DiacritizerModel.family: tashkeel_nano Arabic diacritizer (bidirectional tagger, not a decoder)

BlindForCausalLM.family: KenT Compressed-QK attention + gated key refinement (Vi-LAB)

MuseSparkForConditionalGeneration.family: Meta Muse Spark Open (816B-A42B latent-MoE, vision + audio; upstream llama.cpp ba3c05f71, after the pin)

Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.family: GLM-5.3-Flash (KDA linear-attention + DeepSeek sparse attention hybrid, hyper-connections; upstream llama.cpp 649dcb10, after the pin)

LiveMemForCausalLM.family: LiveMem RL backbone (Qwen2.5-shaped dense decoder, MLX q4 uploads)

CDMMoELMPoincare.family: CDM Poincare-geometry MoE (hyperbolic attention + telepathy gate, 629M, one uploader)

Senryu2ForCausalLM.family: Senryu-2.2 GDN2 + parallax-attention hybrid with repo-local n-gram tables

GraniteSwitchForCausalLM.family: Granite Switch 4.1 (dense all-attention Granite with N embedded per-token LoRA adapters, a zero adapter slot and weightless switch layers; upstream llama.cpp 157b81fe, not in the pin)

Ernie5_5_MoeForCausalLM.family: ERNIE 5.5 Flash MoE (hybrid MLA + DSA indexer, hyper-connections, latent MoE, situ activation; not an alias of ernie4_5-moe, nothing at the pin registers it)

Factorial.family: Factorial selection/memmap LM (repo-local training and inference code, .pt + weights.dat, SentencePiece; not a Transformer decoder, so nothing to alias)

Lfm3ForCausalLM.family: LiquidAI LFM3 (sandwich norms, sliding-attention layers with partial rotary, 7-tap conv cache, tied embeddings; not an alias of lfm2/lfm2moe, nothing at the pin registers it)

NeedleForToolCalling.family: Cactus-Compute needle3 tool-calling model (hadamard MLP, engram slots, confidence head, cactus-quants, .cact container for its own on-device runtime; not a Transformer a pinned backend can load)

GRTForCausalLM.family: GRT rotational/coupling decoder (MatterWaveAI grt-30m-code, 8 models in registry/census.json). Not an alias of anything mapped: the config reads model_type grt with a rotational coupling mixer (n_qkv_rotations 11, n_mixer_rotations 1, mor_router_mode rotational, mor_delta_scale 0.5, coupling_init_mode diagonal, angle_init_scale 0.1), learnable_rope with rope_placement stream, residual_gate_mode bounded_depth, no residual norm, and it declares transformers_version 5.23.0.dev0 - a research decoder, not a llama/qwen shape with extra keys. Nothing at the pin registers the class or a 'grt' gguf architecture (conversion/ has no grt module, src/llama-arch.cpp has no grt arch), so mapping it would claim a graph the engine cannot run. Declined with this reason on 2026-11-07 under engine #1328; the census reports it as . REVIEWED instead of !! UNCOVERED. Remove this entry and watch: report if a backend ever ports it.

RMSN.family: RMSN, Resonant Metriplectic Sheaf Network (DuoNeural physical-informed research decoder: model_type rmsn with dim/depth/slots/seq_len and a Lyapunov diagnostic in the config, card tags port-hamiltonian/metriplectic/lyapunov/sheaf, its own GitHub runtime - a continuous-time dynamical system, not a Transformer with attention/FFN tensors). Not an alias of anything mapped: config.json declares architectures [RMSN] with vocab_size 49152 on the HuggingFaceTB/cosmo2-tokenizer, dim 1024, depth 16, slots 64, seq_len 512, 243.7 M parameters and no attention/FFN keys, and nothing at the pin registers the class or an 'rmsn' gguf architecture (conversion/ has no module for it, src/llama-arch.cpp has no arch), so mapping it would claim a graph the engine cannot run. Declined with this reason on 2026-11-08 under engine #1451; the census reports it as . REVIEWED instead of !! UNCOVERED. Remove this entry and watch: report if a backend ever ports it.

IndonesianChatLM.family: Liwet (fadhilahkhairogi, a from-scratch Indonesian coursework MoE: Liwet-400M-A188M-id-{base,instruct,chat}). Not an alias of anything mapped. The repo ships config.json, model.safetensors and a tokenizer but no modeling code and no auto_map, and the class is not registered at the pin (conversion/ has no module for it, src/llama-arch.cpp has no arch). Its tensors are read from the safetensors header: no 'model.' prefix; per layer, q/k/v/o (16Q/4KV, head_dim 64, no q/k norm), a fused gate_up_proj [8, 1024, 720] and down_proj [8, 360, 1024] over 8 experts top-2, a router.weight [8, 1024], and two non-standard buffers, expert_bias [8] and load_ema [8], alongside router_bias_update_speed / router_load_decay / moe_capacity_factor in the config. Whether expert_bias enters the selection only (aux-loss-free balancing) or also the weights, and whether routing is softmax or sigmoid, is defined nowhere the engine can read, and the config's intermediate_size 2880 has no tensor behind it. Mapping it to a Mixtral/Qwen-MoE family would claim a routing rule the uploader never published. Declined on 2026-11-09 under engine #1667; the census reports it as . REVIEWED. Remove this entry if the uploader publishes modeling code a backend ports.

GPT.family: nanoGPT-style one-offs (first seen: learner-subodh/Delivery-Rider-Assistant-SLM). 'GPT' is the class name nanoGPT's model.py exports, so this key covers any upload that saves nanoGPT's own state dict. Not an alias of GPT2LMHeadModel: the config uses nanoGPT's keys (n_embd 384, n_layer 6, n_head 8, block_size 256, bias, dropout) rather than GPT2Config's n_positions/n_ctx, the repo carries only a pickled pytorch_model.bin (no safetensors, no tokenizer files; the card names tiktoken gpt2), and nanoGPT stores nn.Linear weights where GPT-2's checkpoint stores Conv1D (transposed), so the gpt2 converter would read every projection the wrong way round. Nothing at the pin registers the class. Declined on 2026-11-09 under engine #1667; the census reports it as . REVIEWED. Remove this entry if a backend gains a nanoGPT import.

DeepseekV4FlashSuperExpertForCausalLM.family: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash SuperExpert, published as remote code and with AW-SECD-compressed weights (8.5 GB, claimed 0.962 retention); MLA-style geometry (kv_lora_rank 512, q_lora_rank 1536, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, 32 heads / 16 KV, IM 4096). Not an alias of deepseek_v41: nothing at the pin decodes AW-SECD weights, so mapping it would name a backend that cannot read it

OpensciForCausalLM.family: OpenSci (1.7B 'nemotron-hq' recipe). A REMOTE-CODE class: its config carries an auto_map pointing at modeling_opensci.py / configuration_opensci.py, so the pinned backends cannot accept the architecture without that custom code. Not an alias of any supported family, and not mappable until the code is vendored or upstreamed.

BagelForConditionalGeneration.family: BAGEL-style unified understand+generate model (first seen: benson123dc/tmp-4461ae1a1900, 4 models in the 2026-11-12 census). Composite config: llm_config Qwen2 (hidden 3584, 28 layers, 28 heads / 4 KV) with qk_norm, a SigLIP vit_config (27 layers, patch 14) and a VAE latent path (visual_gen true). Every LLM layer carries a second Mixture-of-Transformers copy (*_moe_gen q/k/v/o, MLP and norms) for the image-generation tokens. Not an alias of Qwen2ForCausalLM: the qwen2 graph has no q_norm/k_norm and no _moe_gen weights, so even an understanding-only text path needs its own converter.

OleanderForCausalLM.family: Oleander-150M, a from-scratch training export (first seen: CyanMonkey/Test-Subject-3; its own config says step 2000 of 28820, 6.94 %). Hybrid 28 layers in a gdn2,gdn2,gdn2,gqa pattern, hidden 576, vocab 32770, F32. Ships no modelling code and no auto_map. Not an alias of the Qwen3.5 / Qwen3-Next linear-attention families despite the same layer_types: gdn2 layers carry per-q/k/v conv1d and low-rank f/g gate projections, every sublayer has attention-residual mixers (attn_res_*), and GQA layers a fused qg_proj and a value-residual v_mix; no pinned graph has those tensors.
